window.scope: Discrete R-clock bracket inside original autonomous start/end and Observer last runtime mono cap; not exact Observer start/end. Partial failed phases remain partial; whole actual errors/faults retained independently.

action_CDR_capture.scope: Actual ActionWire CDR observations, retries may create repeated samples; not unique Goals

action_CDR_actual_destination.scope: Actual ActionWire CDR observations, retries may create repeated samples; not unique Goals

HubClient_complete_deliveries.scope: Native whole application-body completions with RPC prefix, includes link qualification flows; NOT TCP application-fragment/frame count or ROS-only count

whole_dispatch_statistics.schedule: C/R cached handlers alternate in fixed quantum4; stop after a pair when either initial cap is used
whole_dispatch_statistics.side_span_semantics: max_wall/cpu are accumulated side service time per poll, including pump; not contiguous batches or single-callback spans

native_meta_scope: Gateway has native RX sim stamp only; source_stamp is original ROS header, never native TX. No model TX/admission/PHY airtime inferred, no native ledger or PCAP reads.
UNMEASURED: Per-message exact health/mask receipt_sim (not persisted in these packet rows; final Guard fields are last-only)
Mask C callback entry/socket queue/flush (not traced)
Native model TX/admission and exact transport-only model latency
All-call normal dispatch percentiles/CPU totals (only >=10ms longspans are phase-selectable; whole aggregates remain whole)
semantics: mono_ns/time.monotonic same-host wall; ROS/ns3 clocks named sim and never subtracted from monotonic
Signed publish-end spans may overlap callbacks; negative samples retained and counted. Do not sum overlapping spans or inclusive dispatch parents/children.
Health source age uses actual observed R node clock: A0 after-call vs adapter before-call, not exact receipt_sim or continuous safety supremum.
Mask mono receipt lies inside before/after bracket; accepted predecessor may precede normal bracket. No >300wall pass/fail test under new contract.
Whole capture/delivery hash cohorts and normal capture/delivery event cohorts differ at boundaries; count differences are not loss estimates.
Stage percentiles nearest-rank ceil(p*n), median arithmetic; worst is one actual matching witness, no full-cache copy.
Diagnostic measurement cost and different trajectories/loads/sourceavailability remain; cross-arm differences do not alone isolate CPU or RF causes.

case.source_identity_rule: Read actual case.admission-used.json -> ready_path -> explicit runtime_base/candidate/adapter_source fields. Never inherit another arm runtime.

reviewed_case_verdict.scope: Preserve actual A0 postbudget controller1 despite original raw success;180sim canonical component remains separately usable, no A0 acceptance

actual_source_identity.scope: Recorded actual launch-ready path/hash plus its explicit source fields; no planned-AAE substitution, hash recomputation or source equivalence inference

explicit_reviewed_case_verdict.scope: Preserve actual A0 postbudget controller1 despite original raw success;180sim canonical component remains separately usable, no A0 acceptance

observed_process_and_raw_fields.controller_teardown_error: Fulluntimestamped rclpy take_message RuntimeError traceback retained; actualcontrollerexit1 observed afterbudgetSIGINT. Exactexceptiononset/type/unique cause UNRESOLVED

controller_final.global_progress_activation_basis: First same-session status with any actual R Guard armed; receipt monotonic, not Goal/Policy or bootstrap token
controller_final.achieved_rtf_scope: First physical token issue through latest successful actual physics ACK; not a rate guarantee

case_outcome.scope: Preserve original raw success fields independently from process verdict; metrics/empty ownership do not override controller nonzero

source_protocol: Per-case actual launched admission fields retained, including later C source/observation changes; no common-source substitution or inferred process PASS

native_target_cache.scope: Only matched normal R-consumed health/mask IDs; not full Gateway cache, native ingress cohort, loss denominator or permission to scan ledger
